axes.title: Annual carbon per pathway against PBs

texts: Annual carbon per pathway against PBs
Within AR only (between AtP and AR)
note: Cumulative 2026-2050 25,503 kt (LoE AR 5.76, AtP 22.9); Monte Carlo 90% interval 21,197-30,569 kt (5th-95th percentile of the cumulative carbon of the draws), 50% interval 23,649-27,459 kt, median 25,521 kt (capped bars; the column is the deterministic Reference); committed after 2050 (drawn at the lower bound): C1-C4 5,702 kt (2025 factors) and B2/B4 after 2050 4,026 kt (2050 factors held; 4,960 kt with 2025 factors); Monte Carlo median 9,726 kt, 50% interval 9,069-10,456, 90% interval 8,160-11,519 kt. Committed range from the Monte Carlo floor-area uncertainty (population, household size, dwelling size, completion rate); repair and end-of-life factors held at their central values. Moderate / Ambitious Pathway and TL: deterministic runs. Lines are shape-preserving (PCHIP) interpolation through the annual values, not smoothed across the observed -> modelled join after 2027; bands: Monte Carlo 90% band pchip, Monte Carlo 50% band pchip.
